issue.title: Document that agents must watch bob-mac-capture CI after every push
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `sase.md`

In the Repositories section, expand the `bob-mac-capture` linked-repo bullet so agents always see that GitHub Actions is the only type-check/test gate for the macOS-only targets. After any push to `bobs-org/bob-mac-capture`, they must watch CI to completion with `gh run watch --repo bobs-org/bob-mac-capture --exit-status` (via `/sase_monitor`) and keep iterating until a full run is green. Spell out that Linux `swift build` / `swift test` only confirm CaptureCore, because `BobMacCapture`, `BobMacCaptureInstallHelper`, and their tests are gated by `#if os(macOS)` and `Scripts/xcode-swift.sh` will not run without Apple developer tools.

## Evidence

`plan:202609/fix_bob_mac_capture_ci.md` diagnosed five consecutive red `master` runs after `871eaed` (through `e5d7306` / run `34154292497`). Every run died in job `macOS 26 SwiftPM` step `Test`. Linux `swift build` stayed green because it never compiles those targets, so commits landed unwatched.

This implementation family then needed three CI iterations after the first compile fix, none of which a Linux host could have caught:

1. `33b89be` — file-scope fixture hoist; CI run `34163055815` still failed to compile because `XCTestCase.record` shadowed the helper.
2. `ef4611d` — rename to `applicationRecord`; CI run `34163503387` compiled 425 tests, then two `InstallRelauncherTests` failed because `URL.resolvingSymlinksInPath` does not equate `/var` and `/private/var` when later components are missing.
3. `cf73955` — fold `/private/{var,tmp,etc}` after resolution; CI run `34163916512` on `master` is green: https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-mac-capture/actions/runs/34163916512 (SHA `cf739555728f9915a80daeffbe2c04634b1fea3f`). Every required step succeeded, including `Install and reinstall`.

Current `sase.md` only describes capture-contract coordination for `bob-mac-capture`. It does not tell agents that the macOS-only targets have no local gate.

Related but not a duplicate: `bob-cli-1u` is a Linux `swift test` failure in CaptureCore while macOS CI is green — the inverse platform gap.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction from bob-cli-2v.land (proposed by bob-cli-2v.3 note #2 and bob-cli-2v.5 notes #1-#2): bob-mac-capture commit e9865e6 (task-link picker, epic bob-cli-2v) was pushed to master without watching CI; run 36758703183 (macOS 26 SwiftPM) failed at step Test with a test-target compile error (TaskLinkPickerPresentationTests.swift:488/494, 'CapturePickerPresentation' has no member 'pullForwardLine'), so none of the new Swift tests ever ran. Both phases verified only 'just format-lint' and 'just build' over ssh on the mac tailnet host, whose Command Line Tools-only toolchain has no XCTest ('no such module XCTest' for every test target, identical on the clean base tree), and treated the red 'just test' as environmental instead of watching Actions. New fact for the memory update: the 'mac' tailnet host is not a test gate either, not just Linux. Impact: a red master was left behind and discovered only by the epic land agent.

Third instance of the same gap, Oct 2026: bob-mac-capture 1056569 (parked pomodoro links) applied a parked-caption branch to the start card whose TaskRow has no outcome, breaking the BobMacCapture target compile. Authored on a Linux host where the target never compiles; pushed without watching macOS CI, leaving master red (same pattern as fe5d1d5, 1c85058). Fixed by f8d530d; CI run 36870778255 green (lint/build/test/bundle/smoke/install all pass). Corroborates that the sase.md watch-CI convention from this bead is still unlanded and still needed.

evidence.note: Fourth instance of the unwatched macOS CI gap, Oct 2026: bob-mac-capture 6a7046e (feat saved-templates, phase bob-cli-8b.5) landed SettingsView.swift catch-as-BobClientError without import CaptureCore. Linux portable-check cannot type-check BobMacCapture; the phase note said the Mac host was offline. CI run 38923816910 failed the Build step with 'cannot find type BobClientError in scope' at SettingsView.swift:342. That Build failure went unnoticed because master Test had already been red since 2026-10-13 (last green 38424226217). This tale adds the missing import. Mac compile still unverified this turn (kellys-macbook-pro SSH timed out). Corroborates that the sase.md watch-CI convention from this bead is still unlanded and still needed.
